def factor_tail_fragility_downside_vol_ratio_m120(df):
    '''Tail-risk fragility: ratio of downside volatility to upside volatility, smoothed with 120d window.'''
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    down_ret = ret.clip(upper=0.0)
    up_ret = ret.clip(lower=0.0)
    window = 120
    minp = 40
    down_vol = down_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=minp).std(ddof=1)
    up_vol = up_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=minp).std(ddof=1)
    total_vol = down_vol + up_vol
    factor = (down_vol - up_vol) / total_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return factor.rename('factor_tail_fragility_downside_vol_ratio_m120')
